fields.name: clk_mode
fields.doc: 0: fabric clock enable = one pulse per TCK rising edge while USER1 ce (JTAG-stepped); 1: free-running divider

fields.name: init
fields.doc: LUT6 truth table; O5 = INIT[31:0] over i[4:0]

fields.name: ff_rstval
fields.doc: INIT and sync reset value: FDRE=0 / FDSE=1

fields.name: ff_ce_en
fields.doc: 1: FF honours the routed CE, 0: always enabled

fields.name: ff_sr_en
fields.doc: 1: FF honours the routed SR, 0: reset ignored

fields.name: cy_en
fields.doc: carry mode: XORCY sum on datapath, MUXCY cout

fields.name: wmode_a
fields.doc: port A write mode: 0 WRITE_FIRST, 1 READ_FIRST, 2 NO_CHANGE

fields.name: jtag_a
fields.doc: port A pins from the USER4 drive word instead of the fabric

fields.name: jtag_b
fields.doc: port B pins from the USER4 drive word instead of the fabric

fields.name: jtag_a
fields.doc: bus A from the DSP JTAG drive word

fields.name: jtag_b
fields.doc: bus B from the DSP JTAG drive word

fields.name: jtag_c
fields.doc: bus C from the DSP JTAG drive word

fields.name: jtag_d
fields.doc: bus D from the DSP JTAG drive word

fields.name: jtag_ctrl
fields.doc: CE/RST controls from the DSP JTAG drive word

rr.doc: nodes: [id, type, xlow, ylow, xhigh, yhigh, ptc, direction]; muxes: [node, chain_lo, width, base, [input nodes]] - value base+i selects input i, 0 const0, 1 const1 (IPIN only); directs: [ipin, opin]

chain.order: ctrl tile first, then grid tiles row-major from (0,0) (the fields of the block rooted there, then its routing muxes by rr node id), then reserved bits to a byte boundary
chain.bit_order: chain bit k is the k-th bit shifted in on TDI (LSB-first)

bsr.cells: cell k (bit k, cell 0 nearest TDO): k < NPAD output cell of pad k (fabric -> world, GTS-gated), k >= NPAD input cell of pad k-NPAD (world -> fabric)

bram.drive: 64 bits per BRAM: port A pins [31:0] (addr, di, we, en, rst, regce), port B [63:32]

dsp.cascade: dsp1.pcin <- dsp0.pcout (= P), a VPR direct; dsp0.pcin = 0
